text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl ran superbly at the Oka 
Sho as well, showing off her world-class 
strength for all to see.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! I felt a million times more 
responsive than during the Hanshin JF...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The mile really is my best distance after 
all! However—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure it's okay to give up on the 
Oaks' 2400m? I mean, beyond that lies—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, our next goal comes down to two 
choices, right? Meaning...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Should we go for the NHK Mile Cup, or the 
Oaks?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, of course it turned out that way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the mile—1,600 meters—really is her 
best fit, then the GⅠ NHK Mile Cup should 
be our target.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, if she can handle 
2400m, she'll stay on the Triple Tiara 
path. The Japanese Oaks would be her next 
goal, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Today's race made me realize, Trainer. 
That for me—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the mile really is your best 
distance.
choice_data_list: I see. Then how about the NHK Mile Cup?

I see, then shall we go with the NHK Mile 
Cup?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Things won't be that easy, however. And 
that is because...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Because my ultimate goal is "winning a 
European GⅠ." And then—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Europe's greatest "GⅠ race" is 2400 
meters, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying. It's France's 
pinnacle GⅠ race that everyone in the 
Umamusume world dreams of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even among GⅠ races, if I can target 
whatever I want, that's what I want to aim 
for. The question is, how far should I 
push it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The greatest glory... The most dazzling 
dreeeeam...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"There is no one who cannot be captivated. 
Everyone wants to chase after it every 
single day..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe these legs of mine can reach it! If 
luck is on my side, then just maybe...!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Still... let's not.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With strong self-control, Seeking the 
Pearl reined herself in.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there are several reasons. First, the 
European turf—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"That deep turf will sap your stamina down 
to the roots. Barely managing 2400 meters 
won't even put you in the conversation."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And even bigger than that is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Our goal isn't to chase some obvious dream 
that anyone else would pursue, is it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, what matters is 
maximizing your own potential and showing 
your possibilities to the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Courage is not the same as recklessness. 
And what I want to show everyone—is true 
courage.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
At shorter distances up to the mile, we 
can take on the world. Let's make sure we 
don't go missing our original objective.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The thoughtfulness hidden behind her 
flashy exterior... This was yet another 
strength held by Seeking the Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She knows how to maintain self-control at 
crucial moments. If Seeking the Pearl 
thinks this way, there's no need to 
hesitate.
choice_data_list:
Alright! Let's make the NHK Mile Cup our 
next goal!

Let's make our next goal the NHK Mile Cup, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay. If you agree, then there's no 
problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to look down. There are 
prestigious mile races in the European GⅠs 
as well. And—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
As long as we're aiming for that, we can't 
afford to fall behind domestically! The 
Umamusume gathering at the NHK Mile Cup 
will be even tougher than the Oka Sho!
